map.购买到不符合食品安全标准的食品，按《食品安全法》计算十倍赔偿。: For food that does not meet food safety standards, compute tenfold compensation per the Food Safety Law.
map.价款十倍不足 1000 元的，按 1000 元保底赔偿。: If ten times the price is less than 1000 yuan, the minimum compensation is 1000 yuan.
map.造成人身损害的，可另行主张损失三倍赔偿（消法第 55 条第 2 款）。: For personal injury, a separate 3x damages claim (Consumer Law Article 55(2)) may be pursued.

map.标签瑕疵也能十倍赔偿吗？: Can label defects also get tenfold compensation?
map.若仅属标签瑕疵但不影响食品安全且不会误导，法院可能不支持十倍；明知不符合安全标准: If it is only a label defect that does not affect food safety and is not misleading, courts may not support tenfold; it applies only when knowingly operating non-compliant food, requiring evidence per specific circumstances.
map.食品领域优先适用食安法退一赔十；若同时构成消费欺诈且造成人身损害，可就损失主张消: In food, the Food Safety Law 10x compensation applies first; if it also constitutes consumer fraud and causes personal injury, the 3x under Consumer Law may be claimed for losses; the two are handled separately per request.
